photos.llama_desc: A group of three children, two girls and one boy, stand in front of a large, round, interactive screen. The screen features a cartoon-like image of a snail with wings, a rainbow, and a question: "What goes on top?" The children are standing on a yellow and blue platform, with a yellow rail in front of them. The boy is wearing a red and grey jacket, while the girls are wearing a blue and a white and grey hoodie.

A group of children in variously colored soccer jerseys and shorts running across a grassy field. A pink ball is in the foreground, and a few adults are standing on the field, some of them holding soccer balls. A few people are standing on the far side of the field, and a few trees are in the background.

A woman in a red top and khaki pants stands next to a table with a white tablecloth, surrounded by numerous gifts and gift bags. The woman has long dark hair and is wearing a red top with a V-neck and a pair of khaki pants. The table is covered with a white tablecloth and is covered in a variety of gifts and gift bags, including several large gift boxes, several gift bags, and several smaller gifts.

A woman in a black shirt with a white logo on her left chest, surrounded by three children, one boy and two girls, all with long hair, smiling and hugging her. The woman is sitting at a table with a white tablecloth, with a white plate in front of her with a lit birthday cake with a single candle. The children are standing behind her, with their arms around her.
A group of children in front of a yellow school bus. They are wearing paper crowns and have paper flowers in their hair. They are standing on a concrete road.

A group of five children, all wearing bunny ears, stand in front of a green metal railing. The children are dressed in Easter-themed outfits, with the girls wearing pink and yellow plaid dresses and the boys wearing pink and orange shirts. The girls are holding small Easter-themed bags and one of the girls is holding a baby.

A plate of food on a wooden table. A sandwich is cut in half and served on a checkered paper plate, with a few chips and a pair of sunglasses on the side. The table is in a dimly lit, casual restaurant or bar, with a few people sitting at a table in the background.

A group of children and adults in a bowling alley. They are standing in a line, smiling and looking at the camera. The children are wearing casual, casual- to- dressy clothing, and some of them are wearing shoes.

A woman in a red and white Detroit Red Wings jersey holding the Stanley Cup. She is standing on a white platform, holding the trophy above her head with both hands, her arms and the cup's top end of the handle visible. The woman's hair is long and blonde, and she is wearing a red and white scarf around her neck.

A young girl in a red tartan dress and a purple "Happy Birthday" headband sits at a table with a chocolate birthday cake with lit candles. The cake has a large "3" candle and several smaller ones. The girl is wearing a red tartan dress with a black turtleneck underneath.
